name: Flag Dial
summary: A phone number field with drawn country flags, live national formats and a flag that waves on a pole
about: A mobile number input with twelve countries, every flag drawn in SVG. Pick a country from the searchable list and the big flag lowers down its pole, swaps and runs back up waving; the number formats itself as you type with a ghost of the digits still to come, checks the length and how mobiles start there, and drops a leading 0. Paste or type a number with +code or 00 and the country switches by itself; saved numbers stack up below with a ringing phone.
how: Press the flag and code to open the list; search by name or code, use the arrow keys and Enter, Escape to close
Type the number: it formats live, shows the digits still to come and says if the start or length is wrong
Paste or type a number starting with + or 00 and the country switches to match
Press Save number or Enter once it shows a tick; remove saved numbers with the cross
